item.description:
### Fixes
- Clicking a site in the sidebar no longer scrolls the list to put that site in the middle. The list still brings a site into view when you open it from the menu bar or add a new one.
Still made for **Patchy 1.5.1**.

### Ready for Patchy 1.5.1
Patchy 1.5.1 fixes first-time setup on a Mac that has never run Patchy before: setup used to fail with an Apache error, so new users couldn't add a site. Nothing changes in Patchy UI, which now expects Patchy 1.5.1 so it won't warn you about a version mismatch.
Made for **Patchy 1.5.1**. Update Patchy first, in Terminal: `brew upgrade joeworkman/patchy/patchy`

### New
- **Start a Total CMS 3 site.** New Site has an **Install Total CMS 3** checkbox. Tick it, choose an empty folder, and Patchy UI installs Total CMS 3 there with Composer, then adds the site so it opens at the setup wizard. You can pick the layout, a starter, the frontend tools and whether templates are kept in Git. If Composer isn't on your Mac, Patchy UI installs it with Homebrew first. The checkbox can be hidden in Settings › General. - **Update Total CMS / Update Packages.** A site that uses Composer gets an update button that runs `composer update`, so Total CMS and its plugins (or any other packages) stay current. Composer always runs with the PHP your server uses.
Still made for **Patchy 1.5.0**.
